data.gender_notes: Rosalie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rosalie is derived from the Latin 'Rosalius', which means 'strength in the rose'. Roses were a symbol of love, beauty, and perfection in Christian tradition, making Rosalie a name of great significance and charm. Roses were also associated with the Virgin Mary, who was often depicted holding the roses given to her by the infant Jesus. Rosalie is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rosalie is a name of deep spiritual significance. It represents the strength and resilience of the rose, which blooms even in the harshest conditions. It also symbolizes the love and devotion of the Virgin Mary, who is often depicted holding the roses given to her by the infant Jesus. This name is a reminder of the power of faith and the beauty of spiritual growth.

in_hebrew.name: רוזאלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רוזאלי נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'ורד' ו'אלוהים', ומשמעותו 'ורד אלוהים' או 'שושנת אלוהים'. השם קשור לפרח הוורד, שמסמל אהבה, יופי ורוחניות. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם רוזאלי מייצג את היופי והאהבה האלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ροζαλί
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ροζαλί προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ρόδο' και 'θεός', και σημαίνει 'Θείου Ρόδο' ή 'Ρόδο του Θεού'. Το όνομα συνδέεται με το λουλούδι του ροδά, το οποίο συμβολίζει την αγάπη, την ομορφιά και την πνευματικότητα. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Ροζαλί αντιπροσωπεύει την ομορφιά και την αγάπη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Rosalie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rosalie derivatur ex Latinis verbis 'rosa' et 'Dei', et significat 'Dei Rosa' vel 'Rosa Domini'. Nomen connectitur cum flore rosae, qui amatitudinem, pulchritudinem et spiritualitatem significat. In contextu christiano, nomen Rosalie repraesentat pulchritudinem et amorem divinum.
